mass_configs.basis: Frozen baseline: GMTLSV six-seat enclosed cart, 825 kg incl. batteries; 80 kg per passenger.
Six-seat open electric cart class with lead-acid pack: Club Car Onward 6-passenger HP Electric, non-lifted, curb 1,293 lb (586.5 kg).
Six-seat lithium cart class: Club Car Onward 6-passenger XR Lithium, non-lifted, curb 1,005 lb (455.8 kg).
Same lithium cart; passengers carrying about 20 kg of luggage each. Full payload 600 kg, within the roughly 454-635 kg (1,000-1,400 lb) load range quoted for six-seat carts.
NON-PHYSICAL model stress level (960 kg payload exceeds cart load ratings). Used only to test the functional form of the mechanism; never interpreted as an operating scenario.
